The browser displays backend results and streamed stage/handoff events. It does not choose investigation actions or manufacture graph evidence. In the explicitly isolated Track 2 mode, the backend binds to loopback and uses the separately named synthetic graph `vesper_track2_synthetic_test`; the previous `bureau_m84_isolated_test` graph is not selected or modified. Its seed namespace is `bureau_synthetic_v1`.

This repository packages a local demonstration of graph investigation and owner-scoped case memory. The release fixture contains invented transaction IDs, labels, time steps, and directed `FLOWS_TO` relationships. It contains no imported blockchain dataset or transaction attribution. `sourceDataset=bureau_synthetic_v1` is a fixture provenance tag retained for compatibility; it does not refer to BUREAU transaction records.

The office artwork was supplied directly by the project owner. The character animations were restored from the earlier project sprite pack at the owner’s request. These provenance notes are not an independent copyright review or license grant. The interface requests Silkscreen from Google Fonts; no font binary is included in this repository. The upstream [Google Fonts Silkscreen repository](https://github.com/googlefonts/silkscreen) identifies it as SIL Open Font License 1.1. No root source-code license is declared; public availability does not itself grant reuse rights.

The recorded memory-off invocation `inv_207ea0f5e550` selected frontier `731000005` with five Skeptic-valid paths. Memory-on invocation `inv_d223b32bb17a` recalled the Case A memory, passed Skeptic revalidation, selected `731000002` first, and returned six valid paths including `731000001 → 731000002 → 731000003 → 731000004`. Both UI A/B previews reported zero database writes.

The browser JSON export was directly downloaded and parsed during verification: invocation `inv_d223b32bb17a`, seed `731000001`, six traces, Skeptic path validation, seven graph decisions, 12 agent events, and one `VERIFIED_RELEVANT` memory (`memory_e826e337ca49`). This was a read-only preview (`persisted:false`). The downloaded file was 290,954 bytes. In a fresh recording, export again and inspect the current invocation and evidence before submission.
